Name: Pinata Party
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
This mod adds a pinata to the game that the player can break with a wood club or wood mallet.

Pinatas can give candies and sometimes magic rock candy (10% chance).

They spawn every year in spring 26th and 27th.

How to break pinatas:
[spoiler]
You can break pinatas with a wood club or wood mallet.

Hold the weapon and right-click on the pinata to break it.
[/spoiler]
Locations:
[spoiler]
Town
Backwoods
Secret Woods
Forest
Mountain
[/spoiler]
